sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: Security engineer with 8 years designing and maintaining CCTV and access control systems, now extending into cybersecurity through a master's degree and full-time practical training. Combines hands-on field experience with network assessment and reporting skills.

items.label: Physical security
items.value: IP CCTV design, access control, system commissioning, VMS platforms

items.label: Cybersecurity
items.value: Network reconnaissance, vulnerability assessment, Nmap, Wireshark, Burp Suite

items.title: Senior CCTV Engineer
bullets: Designed and commissioned **IP camera and access control systems** for 30+ commercial sites.
Reduced recurring site faults by standardising configuration and firmware checks across installations.
Led a team of 5 technicians; trained new hires on installation standards and documentation.

items.title: CCTV Technician
bullets: Installed and maintained analogue and IP surveillance systems for retail and industrial clients.
Diagnosed network and cabling faults on site, restoring service within agreed response times.
